name: Terrain Slope
description: Steeper slopes increase travel time due to more friction and slower speed.

name: Field Density
description: Higher density of plants increases the complexity of the path and reduces the distance covered.

name: Wind Speed
description: Strong winds can create unpredictable paths, slowing down navigation and increasing travel time.

name: Sun Angle
description: Changes in sun angle can alter the path's visual features, impacting the robot's trajectory.

name: Soil Composition
description: Soil composition (texture, moisture content) influences friction and can affect stability, impacting travel time.

name: Vegetation Type
description: Different vegetation types have varying roughness and can affect the robot's stability.

name: Path Width
description: Narrower paths require more precise maneuvering and increase travel time.

name: Obstacle Type
description: The presence of obstacles (rocks, uneven ground) will significantly impact the route selection and necessitate more maneuvers.

name: Lighting Conditions
description: Changes in lighting affect visual perception and can influence path selection.

name: Sensor Noise
description: Sensor noise can introduce errors and uncertainties in the robot’s perception, leading to suboptimal routes.

name: Robot Speed
description: Variable speed affects the robot's ability to react to changes and maneuver efficiently.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Rain, snow, or fog can reduce visibility and increase friction, requiring adjustments to the path.

name: Robot Capabilities
description: The robot's own sensor capabilities, processing power, and control system influence how it can handle varying conditions.

name: Field Layout Complexity
description: The arrangement of the crop rows creates a more complex, irregular path, impacting travel time.
